source_findings.finding: Actual clause requires return upon Discloser's request and lets Receiving Party's legal department or outside legal counsel maintain a single copy for regulatory and Agreement compliance. SourceEffect correctly separates request from termination, but its norm broadens the actor to Receiving Party. IndependentOpen preserves single-copy scope but abstracts the conjunction of purposes. SourceEffect's extra handled NotMentioned is a task-label coverage difference, not independently demonstrated acquisition reliability.

Both learn request-triggered return/destruction over information and copies. Both omit Discloser's allocation of the return/destroy choice. The nearby fact that Discloser retains title to media is correctly not emitted as Recipient's retention permission. Native correctness and this operative effect are real; full norm equivalence is not established.

Both actually execute a return norm triggered by Volunteer service termination and an explicit prohibition on keeping copies/notes/abstracts. These actions and their cited evidence support the two target labels. SourceEffect retains service_termination distinct from agreement_termination; the ten-business-day deadline is not represented in either task-level norm.

Both leave new effects unhandled. The source's disclosure/use restriction and unrelated return-receipt wording do not establish a return-on-termination duty or post-disposal retention permission. This is an allowed abstention; the historical fallback remains separately marked. It is not an engine failure or a core success.

Actual49 supplies Each party shall;50 supplies return within one month after Purpose completion or a written request;51 preserves confidentiality notwithstanding completion/return. SourceEffect cites50 without49 for its real duty, and also emits a false additional disposal duty from51. Its nda-16 proof uses both roots, so correct native output is not a valid complete source proof. The actual unchanged parse_disposal helper reproduces the false51 root. IndependentOpen cites47-50 for its duty but still simplifies the party/trigger structure.

No operative return/destruction or post-disposal retention provision was identified in the available full source. Both leave the new effects unhandled rather than treating missing nodes as proven absence. Fallback is expected under this supported-proof interface and does not count as learning.

Both acquire termination return and the express legally required record-copy permission. SourceEffect preserves48's written-instruction exception; IndependentOpen incorrectly encodes no_exceptions there. Neither fully connects49's delayed backup destruction,50's certified-destruction alternative and52-53's notice, retention-expiry and continued-confidentiality duties to the return norm. The existential retention target is supported, while complete legal-effect scope remains partial.

Both acquire Agreement termination OR written request, a return/destroy alternative and the archival-copy exception. They omit Discloser's exclusive choice and the whichever-is-earlier/ten-day constraints. These omissions do not change the two existential native targets but prevent claiming complete norm preservation.

SourceEffect's sole used duty cites75-77: a RETURN heading plus You shall upon request by us, ending at a colon. The real action is in78 and the retention exceptions are79-83. The unchanged helper demonstrably emits a return duty from the heading while omitting those action/exception spans. Its native-correct NotMentioned is not accepted as a verified source-mechanism success; nda-20 is wrong. IndependentOpen misses the return duty but actually extracts a permission from79-83, giving the correct existential retention label. Its record-copy/legal-compliance abstraction does not represent the full three-way exception and proviso structure.

Both miss the real upon demand return/deletion clause32. SourceEffect's unchanged disposal_trigger returns null on that exact actual unit. Both also miss28's only to disclose permission and produce two wrong disclosure labels from a retained prohibition. These are learned coverage/relationship errors, not parsing, typing, runtime or budget failures. New effects abstain; historical fallback is separate. No repair is made using these frozen reuse results.

contribution_decision.decision: Close this finite ordinary open-effect update pilot. Retain working G/P, new typed effects, failures and costs as research assets. Do not expand it or repeat prompt variants to seek positives. Before another model pilot, define an actual source-acquisition/update algorithm addressing nonlocal norm binding and justify its difference from the already reviewed grammar/predicate-invention/repair mechanisms and unrestricted control. The two original methodological contributions are not yet delivered.
